responsibility: Implements the core natural-loop infrastructure built on the CFG and dominance tree. It manages loop descriptors and loop-tree nesting, finds and records loop bodies from headers/latches, dumps loop structure, frees loop data, answers common nesting and superloop queries, tracks loop removal/fixup state, and serves profile- and estimate-based iteration queries such as estimated and bounded trip counts. This file is the central owner of loop metadata and loop-tree traversal behavior, distinct from the analysis and transformation files that build on that metadata.
same_name_distinction: Implements the core natural-loop machinery over the CFG, including loop-tree construction/support routines, body and latch discovery, dumping, freeing, nesting queries, removal marking, and iteration-estimate accessors; unlike gcc/cfgloop.h, which primarily defines the loop data structures, iteration records, traversal helpers, and public declarations.
